description: This file defines an abstract class BaseDumper within the Twig templating engine's Profiler component. It provides methods for dumping profiling information related to templates and profiles, including formatting and recursive traversal of profile data.

classes.name: BaseDumper
classes.description: Abstract class for dumping profile data in Twig's profiling system. Handles recursive traversal of profiles and formatting output, with specific formatting methods left for subclasses to implement.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Public method that initiates the dump process for a Profile object and returns a string representation.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method for formatting template profiles; implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method for formatting non-template profiles; implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Abstract method for formatting timing information; implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: dumpProfile
methods.description: Private recursive method that traverses the profile tree to generate a formatted string with profile details.
